# R7/gen1 baseline recorded before implementation reads

Subject: d7bfcce2fabd60647dd22f69d6dee027329f63c8. Audit-key: greenfield:reconciliation:R7. Scope: original OG-1..OG-5, M7 owner choices and later M7 gates, not an audit of every other epic's implementation.

[Observed] The effective target is the 2026-10-21 owner answer: one answered packet; estate stays in place; 30 installed/candidate RFC pairs stay; both generated reports stay committed; ten governed scripts stay as standing remainder; the byte-exact two-copy act template stays held by an independent oracle; provider island stays parked and decoupled. Routing-only exclusion may be generated but never filters reliance, citer or digest sweeps. GP-Q1 moves evidence only behind the four-part verified-index/protected-tag gate; it is not permission to change retention unilaterally. GP-Q7 authorizes only a reviewed candidate CC-SEC-3 amendment with explicit costs, not adoption or the execution flag.

[Inferred] Interface-first sketch: preserve existing owner-record interface, exact act reader and independent recorder oracle, field-parsed successor readers with their documented refusals, one explicit execution-rule gate defaulting off, one launched-run marker gate shared by choice and issuance, explicit credential probe/list/declaration boundary, inert parked provider graph, one routing exclusion predicate separate from comprehensive evidence/reliance scans, one immutable mirrored RFC population, and a candidate packet/impact/decision surface that records unresolved owner choices. Waiting-session and package readers implementing the same sign-off contract should agree on date, withdrawal, version, principal and digest defaults/refusals. No new external consumer was demonstrated by the original audit; same-repo paths do not justify compatibility outside owner-selected preservation.

[Inferred] From scratch under these choices, each surface has one small interface. Multiple encodings remain only where the owner explicitly retained the independent two-copy oracle or mirrored artifact. Tests use fixtures, one gate species per behavior, exact populations for preservation scans, controlled falsifiers at each claimed enforcement predicate, and no observed repository bodies. Expected audit output is a finite delta and deduped ledger; no product implementation or governance rewrite. Size estimates would be misleading for historical signed estate; report population and behavior rather than arbitrary LOC deletion goals.

[Unknown] Whether implementation and enforcement cover that entire target; whether the future-dated waiting-session gap has been repaired; whether every claimed output is actually byte-identical. These require the following implementation audit.
